text:
Yes, our guidance lists the peace lily as **not pet-safe**, so it isn't recommended for homes with dogs. That's all our policy says about it, so for specifics on how it affects dogs, please ask your vet.

**If your dog may have eaten any part of a peace lily**, contact your vet or local poison control immediately, before anything else. After that, let us know and we'll escalate to a Support Lead.

If you're looking for pet-safe alternatives, we list these as pet-safe:
- Calathea
- Spider plant
- Parlour palm
- Boston fern
- Peperomia

A Plant Care Specialist can also give free advice on choosing plants for a home with pets. They're available by chat 9am-5pm Mon-Fri (your local time), or you can email help@leafy.example and get a reply within 1 business day.
